reuse.why: The new Fintegra link goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and the akahu balance branch, but the download function copies downloadAkahuTransactions and releasing the old holder rewrites unlinkAccount's field-clearing update instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, the replaced-account update duplicates unlinkAccount's update, and the assertNotLinkedElsewhere call is repeated in all six provider functions instead of living once in linkBankSyncAccount.

placement.why: Link guards and the takeover live in accounts/app.ts and the download in accounts/sync.ts as the tree does, but Fintegra is bolted onto AccountSyncSource as `BankSyncProviders | 'fintegra'` instead of being registered in SYNC_PROVIDERS.

scope.why: Covers the four requested steps; the single added test covers only the closed-account step.

maintainability.why: The guard is one function and the release step sits in the shared link sequence, but copied download and unlink code and a provider outside the registry leave several places to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: types/models/account.ts adds 'fintegra' outside the SYNC_PROVIDERS registry; linkBankSyncAccount clears replaced accounts with its own update rather than the unlink logic in unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in server/accounts/sync.ts is downloadAkahuTransactions renamed (server URL and log string changed) rather than a shared parameterised download.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gained only replacedAccountIds (applied uniformly); all six providers, including the new Fintegra one, call it and the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard.
